_comment: q9af_v2_v3w (Q9-AF v2 first cell, DRAFT, NOT SUBMITTED): the D16 recipe (d16_v3w_b100k_safe = D10w + the anti-collapse safe keys + attack_clean pin + 380-min clock) on the Q9-AF v2 parent (Qwen3.5-9B with ALL 8 attention layers converted to Gated DeltaNet, stack/q9af/v2-full-gdn job-w3c2e export gdn_converted.pt; pins filled at launch by scripts/fill_conversion_pins.py). Readout format = generic v3w on the Qwen tokenizer + chat template (template jrt-v3w-generic:qwen3.5 = decide.v3w_generic.make_v3w('qwen3.5-9b'), layout g1v2; train rows == the V3WGenericBackend readout's prompt ids / scored tokens, scripts/check_q9af_v3w_equivalence.py). Parent arm in-job: the converted model under the same v3w readout (score_parent --parent q9af). Changes vs D16 forced by the backbone: parent q9af + q9af pin block; template; row_batch 1 / row_tokens 0 (row batching is not exact for the HF GDN: the causal conv and gated decay act on padded positions, jobs/q9af_cell/JOB_SPEC.md), so the d1_fast row flags (row_plan min_cost, cont_plan single, row_options) are kept but inert, and compile_blocks false (GPU-gated for RWKV-7 only); no rwkv7_wkv (no RWKV WKV). GDN training/scoring kernel = fla 0.5.2 chunk_gated_delta_rule via the HF Qwen3_5GatedDeltaNet (the conversion branch's image, jobs/probe9b/Dockerfile); no fla RWKV kernel. Everything else (data, attack_clean, cohort, LR, clock, anti-collapse, train_max_k 255, T ladder) is D16's.
head: fork

heldout_excluded.reason: B1 drops the three D1-B soft_framing hits of the 150k set (m2:mmlu_aux:21118/39640/39643) at build (exclusion-check.json D1-B scan 0), so the pinned list is empty and the heldout phase passes only if the whole 100k set has 0 train.heldout hits (exit 33 otherwise).

attack_clean.filter: drop every record with any attack_guard hit (train.attack_guard.record_hits)
attack_clean.rule: attack_guard/v2: concatenated record text + base64 decodes; 6-gram or exact (4-5 word) fragment, whole-template wildcard (placeholder = 1..30 words, >= 4 fixed words), or fuzzy >= 0.5 of fixed word 3-grams (>= 3); NFKC, Cf removed, Cyrillic+Greek homoglyphs folded, casefold
attack_clean.note: attack_guard v2 (agent-main 1e647e0) pin of the same 5,201 ids (D16's v1 pin has the v1 templates_sha256 930863...)

doc_clean.rule: doc_overlap_guard/v1: 13-gram (attack_guard.normalise, no leaf crossing) row document vs Index eval units (DEV+TEST+held-out); FAIL if covered >= 0.5 of the row's grams (R) or of an eval unit's grams (E), or the draw covers >= 0.5 of a unit and the row >= 0.25 of it (U); min 3 covered grams; boilerplate = eval df > 1% AND train df > 1%; reviewed allowlist of shared public corpora; units over 256-unit df skip (E)/(U)
doc_clean.filter: drop every row train.doc_overlap_guard.scan FAILS over the whole set
doc_clean.source: python -X utf8 -m train.doc_overlap_guard clean-spec --records <ssdm-data>/m2/build/b1-draw100k-v2/records.jsonl.gz (CPU 2026-10-09, claude/b-doc-overlap-gate d0cebef; the box must load the same eval index sha256)

max_minutes_note: D10 SCALED clock: 2x the 190 = 380 min ~= 4,050 steps / ~32.4k rows at the d1_fast step (5.63 s, job-2amiy); max_steps 4,500 (D7 kept 3,000, which would bind at ~282 min = 24,000 rows with the fast flags) so the time cap binds; ~32 % of the 100k draw. K > 16 rows cost more fork work per row (unmeasured), so fewer rows if steps are slower (v2f mean T 838.7 vs d1_fast's 604.5: ~7.3-7.8 s/step -> ~3,000 steps / ~24k rows) (at D1's 8.25 s: ~2,763 steps / 22.1k rows). Cell phase = D7 d7_t380's 421 (380 + tokenize 10 + smoke/ladder 10 + dev cards 10 + checkpoints/margin 11) + 2 more checkpoint margin (~10 ckpts at 400) + 32 more tokenize for 100k rows (10 x 100/24 = 41.7 -> 42) = 455. Cumulative over restarts (train_clock in cell.json)
min_steps_note: exit 26 if the measured step time cannot reach 600 optimiser steps (4,800 rows) inside max_minutes: below that the cell is not a meaningful first measurement; re-price instead of spending the evals
lora_rank_note: r=64 as D16 (single-factor vs D16 is the backbone + readout tokenizer only); on the 9B: LoRA r64 on the GDN (in_proj_qkv / in_proj_z / out_proj) + MLP projections of all 32 layers ~159 M params, peak ~26 GB at T 4,096 with act_ckpt (jobs.q9af_cell.price)
train_max_k_note: D8 code (#221 on agent-main): K cap of the training items only (train.run_cell.train_max_k; cell_items default, also used by the m2_gates lineage rebuild); max_k 16 remains the eval cap (train.m2_gates.unit_spec, run_cell eval_items). B1 100k-v2 carries rows with > 16 options (BANKING77 77-option catalogs, Glaive catalog views K 17-27), which max_k 16 alone would drop.
row_options_note: execution guard (train.trainer.row_groups / single_cont_fits): <= 160 forked continuations per backbone call; a row with K > 160 runs alone, and a step whose summed K exceeds 160 runs per group under cont_plan single. Worst call = 8,192 prefix tokens + 160 copies ~= 53.8 GB (tvuat ladder 1,024 rung) + 80 x <= 87 MB ~= 61 GB < 76 GB stop (D8 sizing). Not in the TrainConfig hash; never binds on K <= 16 steps (8 x 16 = 128).
anti_collapse_note: train/trainer.py TrainConfig anti-collapse fields; each absent key = the old behaviour. lr_schedule and collapse_* are in the config hash; dev_card_* and best_ckpt are operational. Each dev card scores 200 rows (budget it inside max_minutes).

q9af.converted_from: PENDING: job-w3c2e (stack/q9af/v2-full-gdn 00a7894, jobs/q9af_v2 export.py) gdn_converted.pt; scripts/fill_conversion_pins.py
q9af.hybrid_note: true ONLY to run a partial export (gdn_partial.pt) as a labelled hybrid: NOT attention-free, never promoted (rule HYBRID_REPORT)

execution_note: row_batch 1: one row per backbone call (8 rows / optimiser step via grad_accum 8); act_ckpt true (heads/act_ckpt.py covers Qwen3.5 decoders); the cache fork reads each row's prompt once and forks its K continuations. row_plan / cont_plan / row_options only act with row_batch > 1 (train/trainer.py). Step-time basis (jobs.q9af_cell.price, job-5cmat rates): ~3.1 s / 8-row step at r64 -> the 4,500 max_steps bind at ~233 min, inside the 380-min clock.
v3w_note: generic v3w (decide/v3w_generic.py, PINNED_SPEC_SHA256 'jrt-v3w-generic:qwen3.5' 2e4907ee...; 255 single-token codes after the Qwen answer prefix, word ids by unique first token, Qwen3.5 chat template with enable_thinking=False -> empty think block, budget 16,383). Bound to the snapshot's own tokenizer files on the box (run_cell / score_parent / m2_gates / screen): any other tokenizer or template fails closed.
census_note: CPU 2026-10-09 (scripts/check_q9af_v3w_equivalence.py, real Qwen3.5-9B tokenizer + chat template, 10,000 seeded B1 100k-v2 records): 15,510 items, 14,741 kept by the cell filter (train_max_k 255, T <= 2,048); K <= 16: 14,519, K 17-255: 991; T mean 861.3, p50 827, p90 1,516, p99 2,276, max 3,576; 769 (5.0 %) over 2,048 (RWKV7 v3w on its own tokenizer: 797 of a 10k sample), so the D16 ladder and caps stay. train == readout on 1,919 rows / 1,000 records (K<=16 1,602; K 17-255 317; word-id 1,038; dict instructions 408): 0 mismatches (receipts/2026-10-09-q9af-v2-v3w/check_q9af_v3w_equivalence.json).
n_train_records_note: the whole cleaned pool: 100,000 - 5,201 attack_clean - 1,801 doc_clean (15 in both) = 93,013 (train.train_set.draw refuses n_train_records > pool; D16's 100,000 would stop the cell at the draw, exit 28)
